notes: Form 10-K for fiscal 2001 with the pre-2003 numbering: Item 14 is exhibits, financial statement schedules and reports on Form 8-K, so no Item is absent. The INDEX (lines 31 to 53) and the QuickLinks list of Item headings at the end of the converted document (lines 1665 to 1691) are not labeled. Item 7A is printed 'QUANTITIVE' (sic). Item 14 holds both Schedule IIs, with Arthur Andersen's report on the first, inside 14(a)(2), then the Form 8-K note and the exhibit list, and ends at SIGNATURES (line 562). The index to financial statements, the auditors' reports and the F-pages follow the signatures and belong to no Item; Item 8 only points to page F-1. Incorporated (unscored) covers reference-only and nil answers: Items 4, 8, 9 and 11 to 13. Item 10 prints its own executive officers list and is not marked. Both labelers agreed on every label.
